The meal that comes second in the day, after breakfast, is lunch.

Regarding the legal compliance of the provided paragraph: The actions described are compliant with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA). The ADA requires public accommodations and commercial facilities to make reasonable modifications to policies, practices, and procedures to accommodate individuals with disabilities, including allowing service animals. While the ADA primarily covers service animals, the Fair Housing Act (FHA) and Section 504 of the Rehabilitation Act also require housing providers to make reasonable accommodations for emotional support animals. By maintaining a no-pets policy while explicitly exempting service animals and emotional support animals, the landlord is adhering to federal disability rights laws.
